searchOneWay.description: Open the Google Flights natural-language URL (q=Flights from X to Y on DATE one way economy) in a NEW BACKGROUND target, poll until result rows render and the count stops changing, click "View more flights" when expand, read every result row, de-duplicate (each li appears twice, compact + expanded) and close the target. Prices are per adult, one-way. Never touches an existing tab.

from.description: IATA airport or city code, e.g. KIX, NRT, TYO. City names fail. SHA is Hongqiao only: use PVG for Pudong

nonstopOnly.description: default false; keep only stops === 0 rows

lang.description: default en (hl= param); the parser expects English labels (Nonstop, N stops)

expand.description: default true; click View more flights to get past the top ~12 rows

timeoutMs.description: default 40000; budget for the first rows to render

returns.description: {url, expanded, count, rows:[{depart, arrive, plusDays, airline, durationMin, duration, route (e.g. NRT-PVG, ASCII hyphen; Google shows an en dash), stops (0/1/2), layover (e.g. "2 hr 20 min HKG", empty when nonstop), price (number), priceText}]}; {stop:"no-results", hint, url} when nothing rendered
